links.comparator_used: Original J-ACCESS model applied as-is to the Italian cohort, without recalibration or update
links.outcome: Prediction of three-year major adverse cardiac events (discrimination C-statistic and Brier score)
links.effect: C-statistics increased from 0.664 to 0.666 and Brier score decreased from 0.075 to 0.073 after recalibration and update. The updated model performed superimposably to the calibration slope model.
links.quote: The recalibrations and updated of the model slightly improved the initial performance: C-statistics increased from 0.664 to 0.666 and Brier score decreased from 0.075 to 0.073.

design_hint: local validation and recalibration before deployment
